items.headline: Albemarle Corporation to Release Third Quarter 2026 Earnings Results on Wednesday, November 4, 2026
items.snippet: Albemarle Corporation to release Q3 2026 earnings on November 4, 2026.

items.headline: Albemarle Q2 2026 Earnings Call Transcript
items.snippet: Management emphasized the tight lithium market due to strong demand in EVs and stationary storage, with supply lagging demand. Lithium demand up 45% through May.

items.headline: Should You Buy, Sell or Hold ALB Stock After a 29% Dip in 6 Months?
items.snippet: Albemarle Corporation's ALB shares have tumbled 29.1% in the past six months. A pullback in lithium prices has weighed on ALB stock.

items.headline: Albemarle reaches tentative wage agreement with union day before Chilean strike
items.snippet: Albemarle reached a tentative wage agreement with Chilean union leadership ahead of a strike.
